name: Kimagure Furyou Dou
source:
School gangs set up a fight. The winning side mercilessly establishes control by violating school girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
